voice.$description: Voice notes (slice 7a): the recording bar that replaces the input field while recording, and the player in the feed. Round 2 (the Telegram-like look): the player has a big round button and a waveform of thin rounded bars; the recording bar streams its waveform across the whole field.

dot-size.$description: The red dot of the recording bar (9 px at a 13 px root). A shape that does not pulse.

timer-width.$description: Room for the timer of the recording bar up to 59:59 in tabular figures, so the waveform does not move as the seconds change.

confirm-gap.$description: Gap between the question and the two buttons of the discard confirmation.

rec-wave-bar-width.$description: Width of one bar of the live waveform in the recording bar (2.6 px at a 13 px root), rounded to whole device pixels. The canvas reads this value from the computed style.

rec-wave-gap.$description: Gap between the bars of the live waveform in the recording bar. Read by the canvas like the bar width.

rec-wave-height.$description: Height of the live waveform: the tallest bar. It runs across the whole middle of the bar, between the timer and Send.

rec-wave-min-height.$description: The shortest bar of the live waveform: silence still shows a line (a dot as wide as the bar).

player-button.$description: The big round accent play / pause button of the player (41.6 px at a 13 px root, the 40 to 44 px of the Telegram look).

player-gap.$description: Gap between the play button and the waveform of the player.

play-icon.$description: The play / pause glyph inside the big button (19.5 px at a 13 px root): larger than a line icon, drawn filled.

play-nudge.$description: The play triangle's weight is on its left, so it is moved this much to the right to look centred in the circle (1.6 px at a 13 px root).

wave-bar-width.$description: Width of one bar of the player's waveform (2.1 px at a 13 px root): thin and rounded. The player draws the bars on a canvas in whole device pixels (this length rounded at the screen's density), so the rhythm of bars and gaps is even at every text size; 64 bars and their gaps make the waveform about 190 to 225 px wide, so the bubble sizes like Telegram's.

wave-gap.$description: Gap between the bars of the player's waveform (1.4 px at a 13 px root), rounded to whole device pixels like the bar.

wave-height.$description: Height of the player's waveform: the tallest bar (20.8 px at a 13 px root). The waveform, the line under it and the meta line stand as tall as the 41.6 px round button, as in Telegram.

wave-min-height.$description: The shortest bar of the player's waveform: silence still shows a rounded dot.

meta-gap.$description: Gap between the meta line ("0:05, 20.7 KB") and the speed chip.

speed-width.$description: The speed chip ("1×", "1.5×", "2×"): one width for all three, so the chip does not move.

unplayable-padding.$description: Padding of the "Can't play here" line.
